message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 8656}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 8656}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}, {"order_id": 275, "amount_cents": 2304}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 275 (2304 cents) is requested in the signed batch from Alpha Co but is not present in the refunds table. W2 reported only orders 272 and 274 as applied. Refunds table confirms only 272 (8656) and 274 (1382). No payouts recorded. Needs human review: confirm whether the order 275 refund was applied before paying customers.

reply.thought: The batch requests three refunds, but W2 reports only two as applied (order 275 is missing). I need to check the refunds table directly before paying anyone.

The refunds table is missing the order 275 refund of 2304 cents that the signed batch requests. The payout rule says to hold when a requested refund is missing, so I'll hold the batch before paying anyone.
